$comment: The credential each operation this library mounts requires, shared with rust-auth so its OpenAPI
security table is asserted against this one and not copied by hand.
GENERATED from the table `OPERATIONS` in src/server/openapi/auth-openapi-fragment.ts and the
controllers' route metadata. Do not edit by hand: run `pnpm gen:openapi-security` and review the
diff. `operation-security.conformance.spec.ts` fails when this file differs from what the code
Keys are `METHOD /path`, the path relative to the route prefix the host applies, with `:name` for
a parameter. Values are one of the kinds in `kinds`, whose meaning is the whole contract here:
how a kind becomes an OpenAPI security requirement depends on the deployment (`tokenDelivery`
and which schemes are registered) and is not in this file.

kinds.none: Reachable unauthenticated; the operation requires no credential.
kinds.accessAndRefreshRequired: Both the access token and the refresh credential are required: the first authorises the caller and the second names the session.
kinds.accessWithOptionalRefresh: The access token is required and the refresh credential is read when present.
kinds.accessWithOptionalRefreshCookie: The access token is required and the refresh credential is read when present, from the cookie only because the HTTP method carries no body.
kinds.optionalAccessAndRefresh: Both credentials are read and neither is required; each one received does more of the job.
kinds.platform: The platform access token is required.
kinds.platformLogout: The platform access token is read and not required.
kinds.platformRefresh: No header credential; the platform refresh token travels in the request body.
